title: Airline market share
statementMd:
Each airline's share of total booking revenue as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal. Highest first.

Expected columns: `name`, `share_pct`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT a.name, SUM(b.fare) AS revenue FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id JOIN airlines a ON a.code = f.airline_code GROUP BY a.code, a.name) SELECT name, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct FROM r ORDER BY share_pct DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
